title: Message Queue & Streaming – RabbitMQ, Kafka và giao tiếp bất đồng bộ
titleEn: Message Queues & Streaming – RabbitMQ, Kafka and Async Messaging
description: Đồng bộ vs bất đồng bộ, queue vs pub/sub vs log, RabbitMQ (exchange, routing) vs Kafka (topic, partition, consumer group, offset), đảm bảo giao nhận at-most/at-least/exactly-once, consumer idempotent, thứ tự, retry với backoff & DLQ, outbox pattern và ánh xạ sang SQS/SNS/Kinesis.
descriptionEn: Sync vs async, queue vs pub/sub vs log, RabbitMQ (exchanges, routing) vs Kafka (topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets), at-most/at-least/exactly-once delivery, idempotent consumers, ordering, retries with backoff & DLQs, the outbox pattern and the SQS/SNS/Kinesis mapping.
